rule: Expected printed lines come only from the adjacent Calc operation rule, never from an EigenScript run.

sc-1-named.eigs.rule: Calc names do not change double arithmetic; SUM and each multiplication of two 9223372036854775807 values display the same rounded double, while 1+1 is 2.

sc-2-pivot.eigs.rule: Omitted: the review program uses a pivot API layout for which no independent Calc-to-printed-line mapping was supplied.

sc-3-pivot-avg.eigs.rule: Omitted: the review program uses a pivot API layout for which no independent Calc-to-printed-line mapping was supplied.

sc-4-sort-fill.eigs.rule: Calc sorts rows, moves their formulas, fills by relative reference, and SUM uses double addition.

sc-5-goalseek.eigs.rule: Calc double multiplication gives 2.5e19; goal seek for x squared equal to 1e20 gives 1e10 and leaves the control formula at 2.

sc-6-csv.eigs.rule: Calc imports nineteen-digit CSV numerics as doubles, evaluates formulas as doubles, and exports the displayed double values.

sc-7-saveload.eigs.rule: Calc stores and CSV-round-trips 9007199254740993 as its nearest double, 9007199254740992.

sc-8-statusbar.eigs.rule: Omitted: Calc's status bar has no stable textual serialization matching this library record.

sc-9-canonical.eigs.rule: Calc SUMIF returns 20, IFERROR catches the missing VLOOKUP as 0, and COUNTIF returns 1.
